name: Supabase
description: Explore your Supabase projects read-only through Supabase's hosted MCP server: list tables and migrations, run read-only SQL, read logs and security and performance advisors, generate TypeScript types, and search Supabase's docs. Sign in with your Supabase account.
examples: List the tables in my Supabase project with their row counts, and describe how they relate.
Run the Supabase security and performance advisors on my project and explain what to fix first.
Generate TypeScript types for my Supabase database schema.

zh-CN.name: Supabase
zh-CN.description: 通过 Supabase 官方托管的 MCP 服务以只读方式查看你的 Supabase 项目：列出数据表与迁移、执行只读 SQL、查看日志以及安全与性能建议、生成 TypeScript 类型、搜索 Supabase 文档。用 Supabase 账号登录。
examples: 列出我 Supabase 项目里的数据表和各自的行数，说明它们之间的关系。
对我的项目运行 Supabase 的安全与性能检查，告诉我先修哪一项。
为我的 Supabase 数据库结构生成 TypeScript 类型。
